entities.name: Rosetta Stone
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: A granodiorite stele inscribed in 196 BCE with a decree in three scripts: hieroglyphic, Demotic, and Greek. Discovered by Napoleon's soldiers in 1799 at Rashid (Rosetta), it was the key to Jean-François Champollion's decipherment of Egyptian hieroglyphics in 1822, unlocking 3,000 years of pharaonic history and founding modern Egyptology.
